# Original native effect fixtures

`sprite.pkb` is an original minimal baked 2.5.1 document generated by
`generate_fixtures.py` from the repository root. It contains one initialized white
billboard at the origin, half extent two effect units, and a two-second lifetime.
Its diffuse resource is `sprite.png`; callers supply that image when rendering.
The empty initialization programme relies on explicit canonical field constants.
No acquired game bytes or reference implementation code are included.

`sparse_curve.pkb` adds an original scalar curve with omitted native dimensionality
and two matching typed sample calls. Lowering must derive the component width
from those calls while native inspection still reports the omission. Tests mutate
individual return banks to check conflicting-use and component-footprint errors.


`ribbon.pkb` is generated by `python3 crates/wc3/tests/fixtures/pkb/generate_ribbon.py`.
One structural controller initializes three same-time children through independent
trigger batches and routed Position payloads. All three children belong to the
same renderer layer and exact parent incarnation. Their fixed native world points
are `(-2,0,0)`, `(0,0,0)` and `(0,0,2)`, with half width `0.25` and a five-second
lifetime. The renderer is `Default_Ribbon`, mode zero, using `sprite.png`.
This tests allocation chronology independently of particle age and pool order.

`camera.pkb` is generated by `python3 crates/wc3/tests/fixtures/pkb/generate_camera.py`.
It is an original single white sprite with native checked `SceneContext` metadata.
Both initialization and physics call `view.position(0, SceneCtx)`, then the checked
world-to-local point transform with mask 67 before storing Position. Tests use it
to connect native declaration validation, changing host camera snapshots,
unavailable-camera propagation and renderer geometry omission. It has a ten-second
lifetime and half extent 0.1 effect units; it contains no acquired graph bytes.
